item.title: Syracuse hires former star guard Gerry McNamara to take over as men's basketball coach
item.description: Syracuse has turned to its past in hiring former star guard Gerry McNamara in a bid to guide a fading men’s basketball program back to prominence. The 42-year-old McNamara, nicknamed “G-Mac,” is returning to where he and Carmelo Anthony led the Orange to a national championship in 2003. McNamara then spent 14 years as an assistant under Hall of Fame coach Jim Boeheim and an additional season under his successor, Adrian Autry. item.title: Shenendehowa names Dr. Cecily Wilson-Turner first female superintendent
item.description: Shenendehowa has named Dr. Cecily Wilson-Turner its next superintendent, making her the first woman to lead the district, according to the district. The Shenendehowa Central School District said the Board of Education approved the appointment at its March 24 meeting effective immediately.

item.title: Vermont driver arrested for allegedly threatening motorist with gun during chase
item.description: Vermont State Police said a Bennington man was arrested after a reported road confrontation on Vermont Route 7A involving a gun. According to a Vermont State Police news release, troopers responded at about 5:46 p.m. March 24 to a be-on-the-lookout report for a dark Buick with rust on the hood in Arlington. Dispatch told troopers the Buick was reportedly following another vehicle closely and did not pass when the lead vehicle stopped.

item.title: National MS Society's Together for a Cure Luncheon Celebrates 20th Anniversary
item.description: For the last 20 years, people have been coming together across the Capital Region to support the National MS Society, while paying tribute to the network of companies, organizations, and volunteers that are dedicated to making a difference in the lives of people living with multiple sclerosis.
